rubrics.title: ASFAI General Mastery Rubric
rubrics.description: A cross-objective default rubric. Objective-specific evidence expectations refine what counts as a representative demonstration.

levels.descriptor: No interpretable evidence has been collected.
Shows partial understanding or performance with substantial assistance.
Succeeds in a familiar task with some assistance or inconsistency.
Independently satisfies the objective's evidence expectations in a representative task.
Independently satisfies the evidence expectations across materially different contexts and later demonstrates retention.

masteryPolicy.note: This is a transparent default, not a universal psychometric claim. Programs may issue a versioned replacement policy.
